description.value: Chutneys Indian Grill is a fast-casual Indian restaurant chain positioning itself as a modern, health-forward take on Indian cuisine, with a build-to-order menu featuring items like tandoori chicken platters, stuffed buns, and signature fries. The Abbotsford location is one of three Fraser Valley–area branches and offers both pickup and delivery ordering online. Catering is also available for group events.
